stem_name: Magnetic field strength requirements for MRI
statement_text_en: The 3T and 1.5T MRIs are equally recommended for prostate cancer diagnosis, irrespective of the type of MRI scheduled (multiparametric vs biparametric).

stem_name: mpMRI vs bpMRI
statement_text_en: The bpMRI and mpMRI may be equally recommended for prostate cancer diagnosis, provided that image quality is adequate for decision-making.

stem_name: mpMRI vs bpMRI
statement_text_en: The bpMRI could be informative enough for prostate cancer diagnosis in patients under an early detection cancer pathway (opportunistic screening).

stem_name: mpMRI vs bpMRI
statement_text_en: The bpMRI could be informative enough for prostate cancer diagnosis in patients under an organised cancer screening pathway.
